layers.name: Wave — mirror
layers.note: Vertically mirrored crest rising from the bottom edge. Authored as a colour-neutral translucent wash so setVars(color) stays meaningful for the primary crest; comps may tint it.

layers.name: Wave
layers.note: Primary crest dipping from the top edge; flip=true reveals the mirror so the divider closes into a full wave band.

comps.default: Accent primary crest, ink translucent mirror.
comps.light: Paper crest #F4E7D3 with ink translucent mirror for light sections.
comps.dark: Cream crest #FFF7EE with ink translucent mirror for dark sections.
